categories.main_business_segments: SYoung Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the cosmetics industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of daily chemical products including skincare, masks, makeup, and personal care items. The company manages multiple brands such as EVIDENS DE BEAUTÉ, PIER AUGÉ, RéVive, and others, with a dual business model comprising proprietary brands and China Partner (CP) brands. It also engages in overseas brand agency services, providing comprehensive market entry solutions for international beauty brands into China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a 'Three Bodies, Two Wings, One Platform' R&D innovation system focusing on skin mechanism exploration, raw material development, and product application research. It integrates collaborations with universities and supply chain partners to develop proprietary technologies and formulas, including fermentation technologies and antioxidant ingredient research. Production is managed through a combination of self-manufacturing and contract manufacturing, supported by digital and intelligent manufacturing upgrades to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SYoung serves end consumers primarily through e-commerce platforms such as Tmall, Taobao, Douyin, JD.com, Vipshop, Kuaishou, and Pinduoduo, as well as offline channels including department stores like SKP, Sephora, and Walmart. Its customer base spans domestic Chinese consumers and international markets, with brand presence in major cities across China, the UK, France, the US, and Canada. The company targets diverse consumer segments from high-end luxury to mass-market beauty product users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and has established a global sales network with brand outlets and flagship stores in countries including the United Kingdom, France, the United States, Canada, and other key international cities. It also maintains subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong and Shanghai, supporting both domestic and overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: SYoung operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cosmetics supply chain, encompassing product R&D, manufacturing (both in-house and outsourced), and direct sales to consumers via online and offline channels. It manages procurement of raw materials and packaging, production planning, and logistics, ensuring end-to-end control over product quality and delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes dual technological empowerment: 'R&D empowers brands' and 'digital empowers organization.' It invests heavily in skin science research, new raw material development, and product innovation, including proprietary fermentation and antioxidant technologies. Digitally, it integrates AI and big data for market insight, production planning, and consumer engagement. Strategically, it focuses on high-end luxury brand development, global market expansion, and building a dual-platform ecosystem internally and externally to foster industry collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales across multiple channels: self-operated e-commerce platforms, third-party e-commerce platforms (including direct sales, distribution, and consignment models), and offline retail stores. The company also earns income from brand management services and licensing. Sales revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, with different recognition points depending on sales mode.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SYoung positions itself as a rising global high-luxury beauty brand management group with a strong dual-brand strategy. It competes in the highly competitive cosmetics market against both domestic and international brands, leveraging its R&D capabilities, multi-brand portfolio, and digital marketing strengths. The company emphasizes compliance, product quality, and innovation to differentiate itself amid intense price and marketing competition in the beauty industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SYoung reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.24 billion, a 5.69% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 110 million, down 62.63%. The company maintains a total asset base of over RMB 4.25 billion with a stable equity position. Despite recent profit declines due to increased investment in high-end brand development and market competition, the company continues to invest in R&D and digital transformation to support sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SYoung emphasizes its unique value through advanced skin science research tailored to Asian skin types, proprietary raw materials, and innovative product formulations. Its multi-brand strategy covers a spectrum from high-luxury to mass-market segments, supported by a strong digital ecosystem and global market presence. The company differentiates itself by integrating R&D and digital capabilities to deliver effective, safe, and consumer-centric beauty solutions, while fostering a collaborative industry ecosystem.
